description: This file defines the LocationAttributeType class in Java, which is an entity class representing a type of attribute for Location objects within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes annotations for persistence, versioning, and Hibernate ORM configuration, and contains getter and setter methods for the primary key field.

classes.name: LocationAttributeType
classes.description: A class representing a custom attribute type for Location objects, extending the BaseAttributeType class and implementing the AttributeType interface. It is annotated as a persistent entity with Hibernate and JPA annotations, and provides methods to get and set its primary key.
